desc: Ideation: identify structural reduction, candidate approaches, and prefix-scan plan.

Prove/verify structural reduction and prefix property: only A=B=1 bits may be used as off-then-on cycles; all decreases precede all increases; larger decreases first and smaller increases first; selected common-one weights form a prefix in descending order.
Implement the O(N) sweep solution with correct initial Wneg/Wpos, monotone pointer updates, prefix cost evaluation, and 64-bit-safe arithmetic.
Test on the provided samples and edge cases (N=1, all equal, ties, all zeros/ones, large values) and fix any failures.
